title: Govern AI agent access with Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore – Part 1
summary: An AI agent that acts for a user raises an identity question that per-app OAuth and service accounts leave open: which agent may act for which user, and how you stop it. In this first post of two, you build a task agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that governs access through Okta
reason: How-to tutorial on governing AI agent access using existing Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore; not a named model release, research artifact, industry business event, policy action, or new open-source tool/framework release.
